messages:
Sophie: FYI onboarding for GCP Marketplace listing for partner 'EdgeScale' is blocked — their SKU taxonomy doesn't line up with our ECS mapping. Procurement can't produce a PO until SKUs normalize. Any quick wins? :wave:

Raj: Ugh. Can you drop the sample PO/CSV from the partner so I can inspect the columns?

Sophie: Pasting a redacted snippet below (removed PII):
```
po_number, vendor_id, partner_sku, qty, unit_price, currency
PO-55123, EDGE-OLD, ES-VM-XL, 10, 1200, EUR
PO-55124, EDGE-OLD, ES-CONN-STD, 5, 450, EUR
```

Mike: Looks like their `vendor_id` is still the legacy alias `EDGE-OLD`. GCP Marketplace requires the canonical vendor_id (EDGE-2024). Partner says they won't change until SOW/legal signoff.

Kyla: Also seeing a legal redline: partner added an indemnity paragraph our legal flagged. That's blocking signoff on the contract side. And currency mismatch (partner sent EUR, our PO workflow default is USD) — finance won't auto-convert.

Adele: Ops quick workaround: we can add a temporary mapping in our catalog so staging accepts `EDGE-OLD -> EDGE-2024`, which would unblock test purchases. But GA must have partner's acceptance — can't fake production mapping.

marketplace-bot: Ticket created — MP-8273. Attachments: partner-sku.csv, contract-redline.pdf. Assignee: unassigned.

Sophie: Action items (proposed):
1) Raj: ask partner for canonical vendor_id + updated CSV with canonical SKUs.
2) Kyla: escalate legal redline to partner counsel, propose removing the clause or acceptable alternative.
3) Adele: provision temporary mapping in staging for test purchases only.
4) Mike: coordinate currency/PO workflow with finance (conversion or EUR acceptance).
Can someone claim ownership?

Raj: I can own the outreach. Pinged partner in thread and DMing their onboarding PM now. Will post reply here. :phone:

Kyla: I'll escalate to partner counsel and propose a minimal redline that legal can accept. cc @Sophie @Mike

Adele: I'll implement the staging mapping and post the mapping JSON snip after it's done (will mark as staging-only).

Adele: Mapping applied in staging — snippet: 
```json
{
  "staging_mappings": [
    {"incoming_vendor_id": "EDGE-OLD", "canonical_vendor_id": "EDGE-2024", "note": "temp mapping for staging tests; expires in 7 days"}
  ]
}
```

Mike: Noted. I'll open a finance case to accept EUR POs for this partner and document the conversion step. If finance can't, we need partner to reissue PO in USD.

Sophie: Good. If we don't have partner agreement on vendor_id + redlines by Friday EOD, we'll escalate to Partnerships Director and loop in Partner Success.

marketplace-bot: Reminder — scheduled sync with partner tomorrow 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent).

Raj: Partner replied — they said legal is slow but will try to push vendor_id change into their next sprint. Shared a tentative updated CSV, attaching when I get it.

Kyla: Thanks. I'll keep legal on this. If partner won't remove the indemnity, we'll propose a clause alternative and mark out as exception in the contract tracker.

Sophie: Perfect. Keep updates short here. If anyone hits a blocker, drop it in MP-8273 and tag me. :triangular_flag_on_post:
